verdict.rationale: Retell documents both a free in-dashboard web-call test mode (no phone number needed) and a Conductor 'simulation tests' feature that explicitly plays out scenarios against the agent 'to check changes without making real phone calls,' plus AI QA that automatically evaluates sampled calls against configured rules/metrics — directly matching simulated-conversation and eval workflows before going live. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of simulation/eval accuracy and no detail on batch regression-testing tooling beyond Conductor's ad-hoc scenarios.
